asOf: snapshot UTC day-end AND original confirmation Audit timestamp <= asOf
snapshotSelection: latest eligible per exact position; repeated date conflicts fail closed
missing: unresolved; never derive a position from transactions
researchExposure: qualitative only; exact Expression revision and confirmation; original Thesis/Claim/Evidence authority
supersede: never replace historical pins; successor at or before cutoff blocks new link; existing link needs review
planning: append-only confirmed target revisions and task reviews; no ledger writes
execution: blocked without FX, price, quantity, valuation, trade unit and complete coverage
permission: read ledger; local user-confirmed research links and planning only; no AI or MCP write

projectionIntegrity.binding: canonical JSON of every read-model field except integrity, created only by projectPortfolio; validate raw and parsed payload before reconstruction; missing/corrupt/future binding rejects
projectionIntegrity.authority: content integrity only, not a signature; original Local Core confirmation/Audit remains authority

accountLifecycle.denominator: all eligible recorded positions remain included regardless of lifecycle
accountLifecycle.nonActive: partial projection; ACCOUNT_INACTIVE / ACCOUNT_ARCHIVED position blockers, account-qualified projection/cohort blockers; UI explicitly discloses inclusion; execution remains not_admitted
